references.text: Moses' promise to Caleb is based on this text where the Lord says that Caleb will be allowed to enter the land because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Moses recounts how Caleb was promised the land he had set his foot on, because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
The Lord swears that none of those who came out of Egypt shall see the land, except Caleb and Joshua, because they followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Caleb reminds Joshua of what Moses said on that day at Kadesh-Barnea, which is the context for the promise mentioned in verse 9.
Hebron was given to Caleb as an inheritance because he followed the Lord, the God of Israel, wholeheartedly - the fulfillment of the promise in verse 9.
Hebron was one of the places the spy delegation visited, and this is the land that Caleb's foot stepped on, which he was promised.
